periods.summary: The Tyrant is revealed as the true instigator behind World War II: he manipulated national leaderships through mental control to weaken the world and elevate Blazers as rulers. Contrary to public secret reports, he was not merely wounded; Whitebeard's force and Ryoma Kurogane killed him, with Ryoma freezing his body and time on the throne. The League and Union hid his death and maintained Rebellion as a necessary evil. In the present, Arlanz takes the corpse and later steals the Tyrant's blood-red Device, Blutsauger, intending to extract an ultimate soul for his experiment, leaving only the empty frozen body as bait.

key_events.summary: His frozen corpse proves the postwar lie around Rebellion.
His missing Device reveals Arlanz's true objective.

abilities: DNA source for Abraham's psychic powers
